patch_description: This redesign separates the algorithm into a planning pipeline: topology validation, balanced group placement, replica allocation, physical GPU placement, and result materialization. The expensive Python scan used to find the least-loaded pack is replaced with a heap-based LPT scheduler, reducing packing selection from O(items × packs) to O(items × log(packs)). Replica allocation is also changed from repeated full tensor divisions/max reductions to per-layer priority queues, preserving the greedy max-load replica policy while avoiding O(redundant_replicas × experts) tensor work. The output format and public `rebalance_experts` interface are unchanged.
